Hook.Purpose: Every enabled rule has severity `'error'`. No `'warn'` / `1` survives, including after preset spreads.
Hook.Command: npx eslint --print-config . | jq '.rules | to_entries | map(select(.value == "warn" or .value == 1 or (.value | type == "array" and (.[0] == "warn" or .[0] == 1)))) | length'
Hook.Expected: Output is `0`. Any non-zero count is a violation.
